generation_changes_required: Discover rig hierarchy and semantic landmarks per asset instead of assuming a universal node layout.
Decode timeline and instance records while preserving unknown fields losslessly.
Extract actual world-space landmark trajectories and phase/contact timing from reference frames.
Use velocity-aware interpolation rather than independently easing every key interval.
Choose IK bend branch from reference pose and facing, not left/right side alone.
Separate character root, floor/background, camera, and screen-shake tracks.
Represent effects as anchored temporal layers with explicit lifetime, order, scale, orientation, and event triggers.
Tie sound cues to semantic events and preserve timing offsets.
Measure foot planting, contact alignment, silhouette continuity, body counter-motion, trajectory similarity, effect-anchor drift, and regression.
Report native-app import/playback separately from parser, serializer, IK, and schematic-render tests.
current_blocker: Full multi-object timeline grammar and per-frame transforms are not yet decoded for the larger references. Do not generate another human animation and call it reference-driven until actual frame trajectories are extracted.
